BiblicalUsage: tsᵉdîyâh is the word for design. It appears 2 times in Scripture, including Numbers 35:20 and Numbers 35:22.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God gave us tsᵉdîyâh because the idea it carries belongs in His Word.
